items.title: Bruce Johnstone interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2013
items.q: He’s kind of like an African version of Ornette Coleman.

ctx.x: He’s kind of like an African version of Ornette Coleman. Fabulous player. And so they were going to do the Berlin Jazz Festival. But they hadn’t mentioned anything to me about it. And I said, “so am I going to Berlin with you?” And they said, “no.” And I said, “oh, why?” They said, “oh because you sound too much like an American.” And I said, coming from New Zealand, “isn’t that the object?” They wanted somebody who didn’t have that American sound I guess I had.
